description: Probe-only evidence for hipkernel:Gfx950AttentionDense (rocKE) on a padded leading stride, crossed with the declared alignment. The SdpaFwd/Gfx950Dense region (BSHD, head size 64 or 128, bfloat16 or half, a (query heads, kv heads) pair the KDP ships for both head sizes, seqlen_q a multiple of 128 and seqlen_kv a multiple of 32, no mask, no stats) over a small shape set, where the row stride (the stride between two consecutive sequence positions, in elements) of the tensors `pad_on` names (q, k, v, o, or all four) is the packed one, heads * head size, plus `pad`; the head stride stays the head size and the batch stride grows with the row stride, so a head's vector stays contiguous and only the rows are spread apart. The `pad` elements after a row are gap elements that belong to no element. `pad` takes 0 (packed), 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 7 (below or off a 16-byte vector of 8 half or bfloat16 elements), 8, 16 and 24 (16-byte multiples), and 9, 15, 17 and 31 (break the vector width). It is crossed with the declared alignment of Q, K, V and O (tensor_patches on uids 1, 0, 3, 2) and with the placement of the device pointers, as in Matmul/Align and SdpaFwd/Flash2: exact puts every device pointer at exactly the declared alignment, under misaligns Q below it (a PASS then means the backend rejected the pointer), default leaves the pointers where they are; under drawn at alignment 1 is rendered as exact. It exists to show whether the engine declines a padded row stride instead of reading and writing across a row of a layout it does not know. Expected (probed on gfx950, 48 samples and every pair): DECLINED at every pad above 0, even a 16-byte multiple; at pad 0, PASS when the declared alignment is at least 16 and DECLINED below. WRONG or CRASH on a padded stride is the finding. Only strides, alignment and placement vary: the input fill stays at its default range. pad_on has no effect at pad 0, so every pad_on but 'all' is illegal there.

derive.eff_placement: 'exact' if placement == 'under' and alignment < 2 else placement

constraints.reason: pad_on names no tensor when pad is 0: every pad_on would render the same packed graph
